### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=True
set -eu
if ! systemctl --user show dgx-model-production.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'LoadState=not-found' 'ActiveState=inactive' 'SubState=dead' \
    'MainPID=0'
  exit 0
fi
systemctl --user show dgx-model-production.service --no-pager \
  -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus
### end
